title: Add warning in SSH dissector when detecting hybrid KEM / PQ hybrid KEM
description:
Add warning in SSH dissector when detecting hybrid KEM / PQ hybrid KEM 
+ add debug info / expert info in actual ssh_dissect_kex_hybrid() function.

Now when an hybrid KEX is detected, you may see this warning: 

```bash
 ** (tshark:741425) 22:46:10.171052 [packet-ssh WARNING] epan/dissectors/packet-ssh.c:1882 -- ssh_set_kex_specific_dissector(): >>> POST-QUANTUM KEX_HYBRID detected: KEX ALGORITHM = sntrup761x25519-sha512
 ** (tshark:741425) 22:46:10.171174 [packet-ssh WARNING] epan/dissectors/packet-ssh.c:1883 -- ssh_set_kex_specific_dissector(): >>> POST-QUANTUM KEM KEX_HYBRID support in Wireshark / TShark SSH dissector may be missing, partial or experimental
```

And in a noisy log level, you will also see: 
```bash
 ** (tshark:741425) 22:46:10.171283 [packet-ssh NOISY] epan/dissectors/packet-ssh.c:1884 -- ssh_set_kex_specific_dissector(): >>> POST-QUANTUM KEM KEX_HYBRID: kex = sntrup761x25519-sha512
```

If you hit function ssh_dissect_kex_hybrid() using KEM like: mlkem768nistp256-sha256, mlkem768x25519-sha256 or mlkem1024nistp384-sha384, you will also see DEBUG INFO like 

```bash
KEX_HYBRID detected: mlkem1024nistp384-sha384 msg_code = xxx
```

These warning / debug info are added while the current SSH dissector work for decrypting hybrid KEMs / post-quantum hybrid KEMs in Wireshark / TShark is still in progress

No, not a duplicate:

It's because how the dissector work:
at this point, if you enter in a dissector function (e.g. ssh_dissect_kex_hybrid) wireshark assume that the dissector function successfully did its job and so bypass its normal processing.

Having a deeper look on what's actually developed show that  ssh_dissect_kex_hybrid() is at the moment more a placeholder for futur work than an effective dissector with the ability of decrypting the concerned algorithm (mlkem1024nistp384-sha384, ...), so for those algorithms it was the good place to add warning (without modifying wireshark standard behavior), but adding a new function for post-quantum KEMs which just print warning modify the standard behavior of Wireshark SSH dissector.

This actual merge request is part of a bigger effort to try to live decrypt post-quantum hybrid KEMs.
At the first time I add a function named ssh_dissect_kex_pq_hybrid() and I add pq-kem related warning inside this function as I did in function ssh_dissect_kex_hybrid(). But doing this, Wireshark bypass it's actual processing of SSH flow when KEM sntrup761x25519-sha512 is detected
(Due to the new dissector ssh_dissect_kex_pq_hybrid() function which is doing nothing else than (only) printing warnings).
So for the moment I remove it and I add warnings for post-quantum hybrid KEMs in the function which switch to the specific algorithm dissector functions, depending on the detected algorithm. 
Also note that the messages are not the same for "standard hybrid KEMs" and "post-quantum KEMS"

Not a duplicate  
As announced this MR is part of a bigger effort to live decrypt year 2025's SSH traffic flow (using hybrid P/Q KEMs), and those warning are still necessary at this point as MR https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19912 only handle sntrup761x25519 post-quantum hybrid KEM
